text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thrilling Cooking Tiiiiime!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yay! *bam bam toot toot*!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm anxious.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Let's get started right away~! What we 
have prepared on the table here is 
delicious, freshly cooked cup ramen~!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, and now, we add a single drop of 
this special seasoning to the cup 
noodles...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And just like magic! Delicious cup noodles 
become even more delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...No matter how you look at it, that 
seasoning seems way too suspicious..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense! This is the crystallization of 
my culinary curiosity! It is by no means 
an experiment to study the effects of 
experiencing unknown delicacies on an 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry! Tachyon and I just tested it 
on our own tongues and confirmed it gets 
suuuuper delicious! So you two should give 
it a try too!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Their switches are fully flipped. Once 
they get like this, there's no way in hell 
they're backing down."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It can't be helped. Both of them seem 
to be unharmed, so I shall partake..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how was it, you two? It turned 
out delicious, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...This actually turned out seriously 
delicious. Honestly, I'm shocked. What the 
hell is in this?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that doesn't happen every day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? It is purely a 
pursuit of culinary curiosity. Even for 
me, delicious food is always preferable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That is not all. This seasoning also 
enhances its compatibility with the 
post-meal black tea—— Gah!?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The tea... tastes like ramen...? Did I 
fail to properly calibrate its duration of 
effect on the taste buds...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't tell me that's—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Awesome!! Tachyon, let me have some too! 
Is it soy sauce? Tonkotsu? Miso?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...This really is the worst.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, everything tasted like ramen to 
the group for the rest of the day, but 
Fine Motion was the only one thoroughly 
enjoying the situation...
